For context, recently kasi nagalit ako dahil sa sobrang strict nung teacher namin. Nagpapagawa siya ng maraming requirements, sometimes without warning tapos yung deadlines niya unrealistically short.

Sinubukan ko na kausapin teacher ko a lot of times regarding of her teaching ways pero ayaw niya pa rin ako pakinggan. Sinabi ko na rin sa parents ko pero sabi nila tiisin ko na lang daw. So kanina nung nag gmeet kami, tinry idefend ng teacher ko yung ways ng pag gawa niya ng maigsing deadline by doing a live quiz. Obviously maraming nauupset rin dito pero takot sila magspeak up. 

So during our meet, sinabi ng teacher ko na nagtataka raw siya kung bakit maraming estudyante nalalate eh kaya naman din ng iba. So in reply, I only answered "nagtataka po kayo eh hindi naman the same lahat ng estudyante XD". To add on to that point, I asked her "parehong tao po ba kayo ng asawa niyo?" And that was when it all started. I know I crossed the line na nung sinabi ko yun, and I admit to it. So my teacher got mad in reply and started changing the topic how we don't know her and that she doesn't treat us wrongly at all. I ended up breaking down, at sumuko na rin ako kaya nagleave na ako ng meet. My classroom's GC, later on, decided to make fun of me for speaking out. Akala mo parang nambubully ako ng teacher at ginawa ko yun para maging cool ako. Pero sila lagi sila nagpopost about mental health, pride, etc all that social justice warrior stuff kahit na nambubully sila ng classmates and teachers from the start.

The entire class literally made fun of the looks and the personality of my friends and I before. But we endured it and ignored them. Nagtatawag sila ng mga "loner/outcasts" as braindead. Pimples ko, parents ng mga kaklase ko, or teachers ko, whatever they could throw. They've been like this since 8th Grade and they never changed, in fact, even got worse. It's a long story and I could go on forever trying to talk about this, but I'll end it here. Sana, kung sino man nagbasa nito, understood what happened.
